# Nyxir

> Nyxir builds Done-For-You (DFY) AI Data Infrastructure for E-Commerce Paid Media & Performance Marketing Agencies. We never run ads, manage campaigns, or edit videos. We give agencies proprietary software to win clients (Product A) and cross-business profit intelligence to retain them (Product B).

## Product A: Client Acquisition & Onboarding Engine
- **Custom-researched Micro-SaaS diagnostic tool** (`audit.[agency].com`) built on the agency's methodology and benchmarks.
- **Multi-channel tracking links** across LinkedIn, cold email, and communities that route prospects and track them through closed revenue and sales-cycle length.
- **85%+ discovery call show-rate** via gated remediation blueprints: prospects run a free audit exposing 3 leaked store bottlenecks, while the 3-step fix blueprint unlocks live with their strategist on the confirmed call.
- **Automated Day-0 Slack kickoff briefings** that fire the second a client signs, passing baseline revenue, blended CAC, net margin, and identified leaks with zero account manager prep.
- **Day-0 Pinned Monthly Proof-of-Value Reports** that destroy Month-2 client amnesia by pinning current verified Shopify performance against Day-0 baselines.

## Product B: Delivery & Retention Intelligence
- **Pre-Flight Creative Gatekeeper**: Scores draft video and static ads (0–100) before ad spend against vertical angle saturation indices, catching tired hooks before wasting client ad dollars.
- **Meta Advantage+ (ASC) Circuit-Breakers**: Real-time Slack directives when Meta dumps 80%+ of daily budget into a single fatiguing creative or past-buyer audience, with 1-click execution logging.
- **Human vs. AI Creative Economics**: Connects creative workflow tags (100% Human vs. Hybrid vs. 100% Synthetic AI) to verified Shopify net contribution profit and refund rates.
- **1-Click Algorithmic Monday Production Briefs**: Directs creators and editors to next-winning angles with 20+ days of open runway in the vertical.
- **White-Labeled Executive Proof Memos**: Compares today's verified cash against Day-0 baselines and prevented budget burn.

## Zero-Risk Data Security & Operational Boundaries
- **100% Read-Only API connections**: Nyxir cannot launch, pause, or edit live ad campaigns. Directives are executed and logged by the agency's media buyers in 1 click.
- **Zero sensitive customer PII collected**: We never collect or store customer names, emails, addresses, or payment credentials.
- **Automated brand and logo sanitization**: All creative analysis operates on structural metadata (hook archetype, narrative angle, visual pacing, audio signature).
- **$n \ge 5$ Vertical Benchmark Threshold**: Cross-agency benchmarks only unlock when at least 5 distinct agencies contribute data to that specific e-commerce category.
- **No inventory or warehouse management**: We focus purely on ad auction telemetry, creative vectors, and verified Shopify net cash.

- **Philosophy**: E-commerce agencies perform the hardest work in DTC yet are treated as replaceable commodities. Nyxir builds custom infrastructure that gives agencies an uncopyable software moat.

## 14-Day Phase-0 Pilot Program
- **Capacity**: Strictly limited to 4 agencies per month.
- **Timeline**:
  - Days 1–3: Research & Map (agency niche, frameworks, and bottlenecks).
  - Days 4–10: Custom Build (white-labeled diagnostic micro-SaaS and delivery alerts).
  - Days 11–14: Go Live (run live leads and test pre-flight gates).
- **Live Demo Node**: https://market-client.vercel.app
- **Pilot Scheduling**: https://www.cal.eu/nyxir
